verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.retellai.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a proper llms.txt index of the Retell docs. Doc pages are also served as raw markdown (.md URLs throughout the docs), so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-readable documentation. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or bundled full-docs export, first-party documentation describing these agent-oriented doc affordances, and independent corroboration of agents using them.
